$comment: Fresh held-out set for the final claim of diddit #4161 (recall-first round): needs quoted (gap title + note, props flattened) from sources no earlier set used: the mark03-mark15 tasklist gaps.json, databrowser/baseline/gaps.json and tasklist/sketch-ref/gaps.json. Frozen in its own commit before any doc fix or tuning of the recall pipeline; scored once.

needs.need: GroupedSidebarSelector: SidebarSelector takes a flat items list with no group headers; the rail is CollapsibleSection + EntityCard rows instead
ControlledCollapseBucketQueue: GroupedBucketQueue only has collapsedByDefault, so a collapse hotkey cannot drive it
EntityCardOwnerTime: EntityCard names slots timing (bottom-left) and counts (bottom-right); owner and time ride in them
FlushStatusRow: flush row, 1px divider, no per-item rounded box; fields name, status, claimedBy, estimate
CollapsibleGroupSection: title To do, count 2, collapsed false, onToggleCollapse, children cards
LocalizationSettings: no locale is stored yet
SharingSettings: no share model in a client-only app
CountedCollapsibleSection: title To do, count 3, collapsed false, onToggleCollapse
TaskCard: title Example task, owner You, time Oct 16, active true, status omitted when grouped by status
TitleEditHotkey: EditableTitle opens its editor only by click or on mount (autoEdit); no controlled open prop, so the edit verb (e) has no handler
InlineRenameHotkey: autoEdit only opens on mount, so an edit verb cannot open the editor on the selected task
InlineTextEditor: value string, onCommit Enter or blur
LocalizationSettings: locale string, onChange (locale) => void
TaskDetailForm: fields title, status, notes; actions new, complete, delete, undo
GroupHeaderWithCount: the rail lists groups with a count chip each; the selector shows one flat list, so the headers are hand-built
TimeSeriesTile: points Point[], xDomain [ms, ms], yDomain [min, max], hoverAt shared instant, hoverSource chart id, onHover (at, source) => void, onZoom
ChartGridSection: kind charts, tilesOf (item) => Tile[]
RangeReadout: start ISO, end ISO, zoomed boolean, onReset () => void
RetrospectiveView: rows finished tasks by week, columns task, owner, step durations
ControlledGroupCollapse: collapsed group ids as a controlled prop so the collapse hotkey and a reload can drive and restore them
